entities.name: Morgan
entities.description: High-ranking Thelonite druid in Havenwood who secretly hated Loren and tried to have him killed.

entities.name: Loren
entities.description: Elven Master Scout on the King's council, target of Morgan's hatred.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Creatures evolved by the elves; Morgan used their blood to attack Loren.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: Planeswalker who freed Loren from the thallids.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent where the elves and thallids live.

events.summary: Morgan animates a tree with thallid blood to throw Loren to the thallids waiting below.
events.quote: Morgan used the blood of a thallid to animate a tree Loren stood perched in and ordered it to cast Loren to the ground.

events.summary: Tev Loneglade frees Loren and kills the thallids with a fireball.
events.quote: the planeswalker Tev Loneglade came across the trapped Elf and freed him

events.summary: Morgan shoots Loren with a poisoned arrow and reveals his hatred and plan to rally the elves against the thallids.
events.quote: Morgan shot Loren with a poisoned arrow, finally revealing himself to the weakened scout.

relations.quote: Having always hated Loren and his family
Morgan was a high-ranking druid of the Thelonite order in Havenwood
